subject: Self-bill acceptance + PO reference & consolidated invoice cadence

From: Emily Park <emily.park@medicore.com>

Cc: procurement@medicore.com

Subject: Self-billing & PO reference requirements for Medicore

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for your time earlier this week. Medicore's procurement team has one technical constraint we need to confirm before we can proceed: our ERP requires suppliers to accept a self-billing arrangement. In practice this means:

- Medicore will create the monthly consolidated invoice on our side and send a self-billed invoice record to you for your accounting; we will include a Medicore PO reference (blanket PO) that should be present on each invoice line.
- Net terms: Net 60 required.
- Invoice cadence: Prefer a single consolidated invoice per month; we can provide weekly detail exports if you need line-level granularity.
- Required fields on any supplier invoice/ack: Medicore PO number, invoice date, invoice total, line-level description, and a unique invoice identifier that maps back to our portal.

Can Redwood accept self-bill (i.e., allow Medicore to generate the invoice and then receive a supplier-ack that we can attach as evidence)? If so, would you be able to confirm any pricing/discount implications for consolidated monthly billing versus issuing multiple invoices?

I've attached our procurement spec for self-billing (medicore_selfbill_requirements.pdf). If helpful, we can route an enterprise amendment via DocuSign.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can move this through AP.

Best,
Emily Park
Director, Strategic Procurement
Medicore

Attachments: medicore_selfbill_requirements.pdf

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear summary and the spec.

Short answer: we can operationalize self-bill but need to confirm a couple of constraints on our side (sales/finance/legal) before we sign off. Specifically:

- We need the blanket PO to be stable (single PO number that references monthly consolidated invoices) and for your portal to populate the PO number on every invoice line so our ERP can match.
- Net60 is acceptable; we'll need to reflect that on the amendment/SOW.
- Consolidated monthly billing is the simplest from our operations side and may be eligible for a consolidated-payment discount.

Looping in Vanessa (revenue ops) and Ben (pricing) to confirm recommended discount structure and any finance enablement tasks. Vanessa/Ben — can you weigh in on: 1) a feasible discount for consolidated monthly self-bill vs per-invoice billing, and 2) any invoice-field or CSV requirements we should share with Medicore?

I'll hold on final confirmation to Emily until we align internally.

Thanks for the loop, Dylan. Quick take from RevOps/legal constraints and what SalesOps can enable:

- Discount proposal (operationally simple):
  * 5% consolidated-payment discount when Medicore allows a single monthly consolidated self-billed invoice and provides a blanket PO number that is applied to every line.
  * 3% discount if Medicore wants weekly consolidated invoices (we can pro-rate pricing, but it increases reconciliation work).

- Requirements for finance matching (to reduce disputed items):
  * PO number in the PO header and repeated on each invoice line.
  * We need a CSV export template for the detail rows. I've attached a sample (redwood_sample_selfbill_invoice.csv) with the fields our ERP expects: PO, invoice_id, invoice_date, line_description, amount, tax, total.

- Legal: self-bill requires an amendment to the Master Services Agreement to note that Medicore will issue self-billed invoices and Redwood will accept them as the primary billing record. Suggest using DocuSign for the amendment.

If Medicore is agreeable to the 5% monthly consolidated discount and can confirm the blanket PO behavior, SalesOps can prepare the amendment and RevOps will enable self-bill processing in our billing platform.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Dylan sends proposed terms to Medicore (summary + sample CSV + amendment link).
2) Medicore confirms blanket PO approach and signs amendment.
3) Finance/RevOps test with a one-month pilot (low-dollar) before full go-live.

-Vanessa

Hi Emily — thanks again for the details. Per internal alignment, here is a concise proposal we can move forward with:  

Proposed terms (summary):
- Self-billing: Redwood will accept Medicore self-billed invoices provided Medicore issues a single blanket PO number that is applied to every monthly consolidated invoice and present on each invoice line.
- Invoice cadence: Monthly consolidated invoice preferred (one invoice per month). Medicore will provide CSV exports of line detail for our ERP matching.
- Net terms: Net 60 from invoice date (as requested).
- Discount: 5% consolidated-payment discount when conditions above are met. If Medicore is prepared to commit to an annualized spend >= USD 500,000, we can discuss upgrading to 7% (requires final leadership sign-off).
- Pilot: Proposed one-month low-dollar pilot to validate CSV mapping and reconciliation before full enablement.

Attachments included: redwood_sample_selfbill_invoice.csv (sample mapping), sow_amendment_template.docx (amendment to include self-bill acceptance). I've also included the procurement spec you sent.

If this aligns, the recommended next steps:
1) Medicore confirms the blanket PO behavior and agrees to the 5% monthly consolidated discount.
2) We exchange a signed amendment via DocuSign (link: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/ABCD-1234-amendment).
3) RevOps schedules a one-month pilot to test CSV import and matching.

Please let me know any changes or constraints on your side and we will adjust. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps finalize.

Best regards,
Dylan Brooks
Principal Account Executive
